artworks.title: Johann Aventinus (Johann Turmair)
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a man sitting with a calm expression, deep-set eyes, and a beard. He wears a cap and a long-sleeved gown, holding a quill pen and book in one hand. There is an inkwell nearby. Text is placed above and below the image.

artworks.title: View of a City near a River
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a medieval village, a river flowing from left to right with a wooden bridge. Hills and mountains with small buildings and structures are visible on the horizon. The sky shows swirling lines and clouds. The riverbank is detailed with plants and trees to the right. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white, typical of a traditional engraving. The architectural details of the village and nature are depicted realistically.

artworks.title: View of Nuremberg from the East [left section]
artworks.description: The image is a black and white engraving of a panoramic view from an elevated vantage point. The horizon is positioned about one-third from the bottom, showing a settlement in the distance with buildings, including a church. In the foreground, there are fields with people and carts. The middle section shows more fields and farming activities leading up to the cityscape. The engraving features fine lines for texture and depth. The sky is left blank. At the top, an ornate frame with text is displayed.

artworks.title: View of Nuremberg from the East [center section]
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a historically rendered cityscape. The city features detailed architecture, a river flowing through it, and various activities taking place. Prominent buildings and church steeples are depicted along the horizon. The artwork showcases precise linework typical of engravings, with a monochromatic color palette of sepia or gray. Figures, cultivated landscape, and bustling daily life are depicted in the foreground, while intricate details of rooftops and buildings are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: View of Nuremberg from the East [right section]
artworks.description: The scene is depicted from a slightly elevated point of view, offering a broad perspective of the townscape. The horizon is placed near the top edge of the image, where the roofs of buildings meet the sky. Nestled on the horizon are the towers and steeples of a town, with a prominent tower visible on the left side marked "Schließtauchtieder." The etching employs fine, detailed lines characterized by meticulous hatching, typical of engraving techniques from this period. Closest to us are several figures engaged in activity within an enclosed area that appears to be farmland or fields protected by wooden fences. In the distance, beyond the fields, densely packed buildings and structures can be observed, suggesting a bustling township. The overall color palette is monochrome, with the absence of color emphasizing the intricate detailing and line work in the historic urban representation. Above the town scene, a large decorative cartouche includes elegantly drawn text framed by ornate scrollwork and cherubic figures.

artworks.title: Meditation (La meditation)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body depiction of a person seated in a side profile. The individual is hunched forward, resting their head against their right hand, and their left arm appears to be resting or crossed over their lap. Their face is turned slightly downward, with a prominent nose visible. The person has a bald head and is draped in a textured material. The background features a detailed pattern of cross-hatching. There are no visible items of jewelry or objects in their hands, and the space is sparse and focused on the figure against the cross-hatched background.

artworks.title: Meadow in Sunshine (Le pre ensoleille)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape sketch from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon line is placed towards the upper third of the composition lined with trees. The trees are drawn with fine lines and scribbles, creating an airy texture. The trees are sparse and well-spaced, giving a delicate and transparent impression. The land beyond the trees stretches low and disappears into undulating plains. In the lower part of the image, there is a small figure lying down. The sketch is monochromatic, with varying lines to create light and shadow for depth. The soft, creamy color of the paper complements the strokes, resulting in a serene visual impact.

artworks.title: English Peasant (Paysan anglais)
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a person with a beard and long, wavy hair, reaching the neck. The individual has a straight nose, deeply set eyes, and is wearing a simple garment. A signature is visible in the lower right corner. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Distributor of the Holy Water (Le donneur d'eau benite)
artworks.description: The image displays a profile view of a person, capturing the head and upper body. The individual is seated, facing slightly to the right with the head tilted upwards. The person has a prominent nose and a long, full beard with no visible hair on the head. They are wearing a dark textured robe and holding a cylindrical object in one hand. The background features a textured surface with vertical and horizontal lines and an architectural element resembling a pillar. A signature "A. Legros" is visible at the bottom right of the drawing.

artworks.title: Fagot-cutter (Le coupeur de fagots)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person working with a sickle. The image features a figure engaged in an agrarian task using a sickle. The figure is dressed in simple clothing and a hat, standing next to a tree with visible roots or branches. The drawing is composed with strong lines and hatching, emphasizing textures. The image is rendered in a monochrome scheme, focusing on contrast and form.

artworks.title: Thatched Cottage (Chaumiere)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint retouched with ink
artworks.description: The image shows a small rustic house in the countryside, seen from a slightly elevated position. A bare tree is in the foreground, with the house in the background. The style is etching, with precise lines showing textures like the thatched roof and tree branches. The color scheme is monochromatic, focusing on the contrast between dark lines and light paper. In the distance, there is a stone wall and simple rural architecture, depicted with sketch-like strokes and naturalistic details.

artworks.title: The Gate (L'entree du champ)
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape seen from an elevated vantage point. The horizon is high, offering a vast view of a natural scene with details of hills or fields in the distance. The etching technique is visible in fine lines and cross-hatching that create textures and depth. The foreground includes a fence and dense foliage outlined with heavier lines, leading the eye towards the middle and far distances. The color scheme is monochromatic, accentuating the shadows and highlights for a traditional and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Philosopher (Le philosophe)
artworks.description: The image features a person seated against a stone structure in a relaxed position, wearing a long garment. The person is depicted in profile with facial features visible, looking into the distance. A small tree is nearby.

artworks.title: Head of a Beggar (Tete de mendiant)
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up portrait of a person in profile, facing to the right. The person is seated with their head slightly bowed. They have a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, a full beard, and wavy hair. The person appears aged or weathered. They wear a dark garment that blends into the background. The background is dark, accentuating the person's features.

artworks.title: Writer (L'ecrivain)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in a seated position, concentrating on writing or drawing on a surface in front of him. He has distinctive facial features, a deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a thick beard. The man appears older, with long unkempt hair covered by a snug cap. He is wearing a loose garment, possibly a robe, and is holding a writing instrument, poised to make contact with the surface before him. The scene is sketched with visible lines and shading, emphasizing the man's focus. The background is blank.

artworks.title: Banks of the Marne (Bord de la Marne)
artworks.medium: drypoint and etching? on light green paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees and bushes, hills in the distance, and a person seated on the left with a long stick. The artwork is created with delicate etched lines, forming the foliage and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of light to dark ink. The fields are depicted with fine line work, capturing the details of the natural scene.

artworks.title: Head of a Satyr (Tete de satyre)
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a person's or creature’s head and neck, with the right side visible. The individual is depicted in profile view, facing to the right. The face has exaggerated features, including a sharply hooked nose and a deeply lined brow. The mouth is open, and a long, thin pipe extends from it. The hair is long and flowing with wavy lines, extending from the head and around the neck. The figure has two large, spiral horns on top of the head. There is no visible clothing. The background is plain and light-toned.

artworks.title: Little Angler (Le petit pecheur a la ligne)
artworks.description: This image shows a person fishing by a body of water. There is a bridge in the middle distance and tall trees to the right. The scene is portrayed in a monochromatic palette with soft, sketch-like brushstrokes, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman Seated near a Hedge (Paysanne assise pres d'une haie)
artworks.description: The image shows a crouched figure engaging in an activity, positioned at the bottom right. A rake extends into the scene. The horizon is high, with sketched trees and hills in the background. Trees encircle the mid and distant areas with delicate strokes implying movement. The style is loose and sketchy, resembling an etching. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, emphasizing lines and shapes.

artworks.title: Auguste Rodin
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man's head and shoulders depicted in profile, facing to the right. The man's position shows him with his head slightly tilted down, focusing on his facial profile. His facial features are sharp with a pronounced nose, high cheekbones, a furrowed brow, and keen eyes. He has a full beard with detailed textures, and his hair appears to be swept back, revealing a receding hairline. The man's clothing is not distinctly defined, as the focus remains on his face and hair. He is not wearing any visible jewelry or holding any objects. The background is plain and unadorned. The artist's signature, "A. Legros," is inscribed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Thunder (Un coup de foudre)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing in a wooded area with twisting trees. The figure is shown in motion, with one arm raised towards the branches above. The environment is depicted with expressive lines and shading, creating movement and texture within the foliage. Light filters through the branches, suggesting a time of transition like dawn or dusk, adding drama to the scene. High contrast between dark shadows and lighter areas emphasizes the natural forces depicted.

artworks.title: Head of a Man (Tete d'homme)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with a side profile, focusing on his face. He has distinct facial features like a prominent brow, high cheekbones, and a full beard. He is wearing dark clothing. The background is a solid, textured dark shade.

artworks.title: Study of an Old Man (Etude de vieillard)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an elderly man with a long, full beard and medium-length wavy hair. The man is facing to the right in a three-quarter view with pronounced cheekbones, prominent eyebrows, and deep lines on his face. He appears to be looking slightly upward with an open mouth. The sketch also includes simple lines indicating a cloak or robe wrapped around his shoulders. The attire and style suggest a historical or classical look. There is no visible jewelry or objects in the image, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Poet (Le poete)
artworks.description: The image shows a dark-toned portrait of a person's upper body. The subject is facing forward with a slightly tilted head. Facial features are partly obscured by shadows, revealing a long beard and mustache. The person has long hair falling over their shoulders. The clothing is dark and blends into the background. The background is textured and dark, creating contrast. The artist's signature, "A. Legros," is at the bottom right corner.
